newsitem.title: CANADA: Thomson Corp Q4 net profit falls.
newsitem.headline: Thomson Corp Q4 net profit falls.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)

Note: Quarterly results for 1996 include a US$31 million gain on disposals, net of tax. Quarterly results for 1995 include a US$309 million gain on the disposal of businesses, net of tax. Without gains, earnings per share for the quarter would have been US$0.34 versus US$0.31.

Results for the full year 1996 included an earnings dilution of US$0.05 per share for businesses acquired in 1996 and a dilution of US$0.08 per share from disposals in 1995 and 1996. Earnings for 1996 included US$156 million in gains on disposals of businesses while in 1995 they included US$350 million in gains on disposal of businesses, net of tax.
Excluding the effects of these extraordinaries, Thomson said its earnings per share for the full year would have been US$0.69 versus US$0.74.
